spec_match.rationale: Implements the motivation verbatim: a classifier that suppresses the Navigation Preload and race-cancellation messages, compared with a legacy any-TypeError classifier, over real cancelled/successful/genuinely failing requests.

interactive.rationale: Three numeric inputs set the session mix; Replay runs it with a progress bar, counters and a per-request table.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches what the page runs.

edge_cases.rationale: Genuine failures are real (301 with redirect:'error') and the page asserts the aware classifier never misses one; on older engines it explains why both classifiers alert.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5124748525830144 and the spec's race-network-and-fetch-handler anchor.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite (7 async script assertions through the same harness) returns 7/7 on Canary 160 and 5/7 on Chrome 159 default, failing exactly the two distinct-message assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing via Playwright (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this environment): Canary 160.0.8176.2 shows the distinct message; 159.0.8154.13 by default and 153.0.8010.12 show "Failed to fetch"; 159 + --enable-features=ServiceWorkerRaceNetworkRequestAbortedErrorMessage shows the distinct message. All controls clicked at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3; no console errors, no failed requests other than intentional ones, scrollWidth == innerWidth on both.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts noise-filter-never-misses-genuine (missed outages === 0) with counts as detail.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only (shared ../demo.css); text pairs are black/charcoal on ivory/stone/paper, ivory on black, rose or emerald-dark on paper.

accessibility.rationale: Native labelled controls, polite status regions, visible focus outlines and focusable table regions; the accessibility tree was not inspected because chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800; tables stack under 40rem; all controls are 44px or larger.

openQuestions.title: Add a Navigation Preload lane
openQuestions.detail: The classifier lists the preload message but the session only exercises the race path; a navigation-preload lane would need an in-scope navigation route.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: Live regions and table regions were set from guidance but not inspected in the accessibility tree (project rule 7b).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table on mobile without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep semantic table/th markup in a focusable role=region wrapper named by the caption; switch to a stacked layout with a container query and inject header labels per cell.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Result tables sit in tabindex=0 role=region aria-labelledby=<caption> wrappers; @container results (inline-size < 40rem) stacks rows and prefixes each cell with its data-label.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Mobile stage screenshot shows stacked rows with no horizontal scroll (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chrome-platform-showcase/654081b3-9e1a-5f02-a6f0-8cd1f1e41633/scratchpad/sw159/shots/stage-mobile-shape.png)

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: No dedicated guide exists for static routing; the closest hit (performance) only advises avoiding unnecessary main-thread and network work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Exception recorded: the guidance corpus has no Service Worker static-routing guide, so the worker design follows the spec, the Chromium source and the existing v140 static-routing demo; the worker returns early for every URL it does not demo so other in-scope requests are untouched.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow, 44px touch targets
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Size every control to at least 44x44 on touch; let components adapt with container queries instead of viewport media queries.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: demo.css gives buttons/inputs min-block-size 44px; control grids use repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%,16rem),1fr)); the stage is a named inline-size container.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: Playwright scan: zero main buttons/inputs under 44px; scrollWidth 360 at 360x740 (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-chrome-platform-showcase/654081b3-9e1a-5f02-a6f0-8cd1f1e41633/scratchpad/sw159/shots)

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region status log for async results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use native controls with labels and announce async results through a polite status region instead of visual-only changes.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every result readout is role=status aria-live=polite; the service-worker readiness note is role=status; timeline bars are aria-hidden because every value is also printed as text.

summary: Default session on Canary 160: legacy 5-6 alerts vs message-aware 2 (exactly the genuine failures), 0 missed.
